ziglar_honest_script: Sir main aapse ye nahi kahunga ki duniya me kabhi koi issue aa hi nahi sakta. Lekin main ye zaroor commit karta hoon: Agar kisi batch me koi flaw aaya, toh company replace karegi aur dukan par aakar main khud use sort out karunga.
